intro.text: The grindings, or grinding coughs, is a disease on Roshar.

description.text: Its signs are hard to miss: a constant, ugly-sounding cough, a lot of phlegm and feverish mumbling at night. Once these show, the sick person is usually no longer contagious.
Treatment centres on keeping the patient drinking plenty of water or other fluids, ideally sweetened with sugar, for about five days. Two handfuls of crushed bloodivy a day also help.
